subject: [PATCH v2 1/4] selftests/mm: open pagemap and kpageflags once for check_huge()

2026-10-09.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the selftests/mm module by opening the /proc/self/pagemap and /proc/kpageflags files only once, instead of reopening them on every call to check_huge(). This is done by introducing two new functions, pagemap_fd_get() and kpageflags_fd_get(), which return file descriptors for these files if they have not been opened before. The patch also takes into account the case where a child process inherits the file descriptor from its parent, requiring it to reopen the file when the pid changes. This change is expected to improve performance by reducing the number of file operations required during testing.
